emerging_technology: Direct air capture with permanent geological storage
intended_application: Explore whether a small long-term carbon-removal purchase should be conditioned on independently verified capture and durable storage.
business_need: Address a residual-emissions procurement question while continuing direct emissions reduction.
users_stakeholders: Sustainability team, finance, community stakeholders, verifiers
capabilities_constraints: Assume an emissions inventory and a limited procurement budget; no project-specific delivery, energy source, storage permit or lifecycle accounting has been verified.
risk_consequence_context: Purchasing unsupported removal claims can waste funds, misstate climate progress and affect local communities.
management_question: Should management issue a conditional 2027 request for proposals or defer procurement?
time_horizon: 2027 procurement cycle; no delivery or removal forecast assumed
additional_context: Hypothetical teaching case created 2026-11-16 for a prospective 2027 decision; organizational details and the proposed monitoring trigger are assumptions, not observations or forecasts. Conventional baseline: Direct emissions reduction and other independently verified durable removal options. Complement or dependency: Low-carbon energy, geological storage and measurement, reporting and verification. Proposed monitoring trigger and owner: Procurement lead reviews quarterly and at contract milestones; revisit when audited net removal, durable storage rights and full-cost terms satisfy independently defined criteria. Hype-sensitive assertion to test, not a fact: A nameplate capture capacity equals verified permanent net carbon removal. Source seed: DOE, Carbon Dioxide Removal program page, accessed 2026-11-16, accessed 2026-11-16: https://www.energy.gov/hgeo/carbon-dioxide-removal. Scope: DOE describes program activity and test facilities; it does not validate the net removal or economics of a particular proposal. This single source is a starting point, not adequate corroboration or a 2027 market assessment. Refresh evidence at decision time and seek multiple independent dated sources; do not fabricate 2027 developments, adoption, costs, regulatory status, results or a chasm classification.
